exp.term.vel.4: Analyzed player data and funnel metrics to drive retention and engagement improvements.

proj.vel.1: Created concept and shipped end-to-end. Designed core loop, UI, progression events, new world expansion, daily and timed reward systems, balanced economy and ran live ops.
proj.vel.2: Created concept, led production through soft launch and ongoing live ops on a rebuilt codebase. 40K CCU in launch week and 66% D1 retention.
proj.vel.3: Owned end-to-end from concept through launch and live ops. DAU +20% during designed live ops event
proj.vel.4: Rebuilt onboarding funnel and reworked level design; redesigned death screen to extend median first-session length. D1 retention +14%.
proj.vel.5: Time reward system: +12 min average session.
